bearing.event.v1alpha1.Actor.schema.json.description:
Actor is who asked for an event: a person, an agent acting for one, or a
 Bearing component. A component's subject is "system:<name>", for example
 "system:scheduler" or "system:loader"; the audit log records that as a
 system actor.

subject.description:
The stable ID the authenticator gives a person or agent (OIDC subject
 or agent token ID), or "system:<name>".

bearing.event.v1alpha1.Actor.schema.json.title: Actor

bearing.event.v1alpha1.SyncRequested.sch.description:
SyncRequested asks for a sync of one source. The sync is identified by
 this event's ID, and its time is t0.

actor.description: Who asked: the scheduler, the CLI or the API.

bearing.event.v1alpha1.SyncRequested.sch.title: Sync Requested
